crossRefs.note: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one…

translations.web: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
translations.bsb: So the total wingspan of these cherubim was twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, facing the main room.
translations.kjv: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
translations.asv: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
